SCHEME: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) – Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
SCHEME ID: SCH-001
CATEGORY: Scholarship / Education Assistance
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: College and University students (Class 12 passed with 80%+ marks, family income below ₹4.5 lakh)
SUMMARY: The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education. Offered via National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide financial support to meritorious students from low-income families.
  - Encourage higher education among economically weaker students.
  - Reduce dropout rates at college and university level.
  - Promote equal educational opportunity across India.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Age: 18–25 years at time of application.
  - Must have passed Class 12 with at least 80% marks from a recognized board.
  - Annual family income must be below ₹4.5 lakh.
  - Must be enrolled in a regular full-time degree/diploma program in a recognized college/university.
  - Must not be availing any other scholarship simultaneously.
  - SC/ST/OBC/General all categories are eligible.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹10,000 per year for students pursuing courses at degree level (up to 3 years).
  - ₹20,000 per year for students pursuing technical and professional courses.
  - Amount is transferred directly to student's bank account via DBT.

APPLICATION MODE: Online (National Scholarship Portal)

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit www.scholarships.gov.in
  Step 2: Register using Aadhaar number and mobile number.
  Step 3: Log in and fill the scholarship application form.
  Step 4: Upload required documents.
  Step 5: Submit and note the application ID.
  Step 6: Application is verified by institute and state.
  Step 7: Approved amounts are disbursed via DBT.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card (mandatory)
  - Class 12 Marksheet
  - Income Certificate (issued by competent authority)
  - Bank Passbook / Account Details
  - Bonafide Certificate from College
  - Passport-size Photograph
  - Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  - Disability Certificate (if applicable)

SELECTION PROCESS: Merit-based selection. Candidates are shortlisted based on Class 12 marks and family income. Final selection is done after document verification.
RENEWAL RULES: Renewable annually. Student must maintain 50% attendance and pass the previous year exam. Income certificate must be resubmitted yearly.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: July–August (annually)
  Last Date: October 31 (typically)
  Renewal Deadline: October 31 (typically)

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://scholarships.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: NSP Helpdesk: 0120-6619540 | helpdesk@nsp.gov.in
SOURCE: National Scholarship Portal (NSP), Ministry of Education
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can private college students apply?
  A1: Yes, students enrolled in recognized private colleges affiliated with UGC/AICTE can apply.
  Q2: Is Aadhaar mandatory?
  A2: Yes, Aadhaar is mandatory for registration and DBT disbursement.
  Q3: Can I apply if I'm already getting a state scholarship?
  A3: No, you cannot avail two scholarships simultaneously from the same NSP scheme category.
  Q4: When is the scholarship amount credited?
  A4: Usually credited within 3–6 months of application closure after verification.
  Q5: What happens if I fail an exam?
  A5: Renewal may be denied if you fail to pass the previous year's examination.
  Q6: Can engineering students apply?
  A6: Yes, BTech/BE students whose family income is below ₹4.5 lakh and who scored 80%+ in Class 12 can apply.
  Q7: Is hostel fee included?
  A7: No, hostel fees are not covered. The scholarship is for day-to-day educational expenses.
  Q8: Can diploma students apply?
  A8: No, this scheme is for degree-level courses only.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Income above ₹4.5 lakh
  - Less than 80% in Class 12
  - Aadhaar not linked to bank account
  - Duplicate application
  - College not recognized by UGC/AICTE

SCHEME: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste (SC) Students
SCHEME ID: SCH-002
CATEGORY: Scholarship / SC Welfare
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government (State Implemented)
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: SC students studying post-matric (Class 11 onwards) in India
SUMMARY: Provides financial assistance to SC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education. Covers tuition, maintenance, and other expenses.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Enable SC students to pursue higher education without financial burden.
  - Increase literacy and higher education among Scheduled Caste community.
  - Cover educational costs beyond Class 10.
  - Reduce dropout rates among SC students in higher education.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
  - Annual parental/guardian income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.
  - Must be studying in Class 11 or above (Post-Matric level).
  - Must be enrolled in a recognized institution.
  - Full-time students only.
  - Not availing scholarship from any other source for the same course.
  - Indian national and domicile of the state applying from.

BENEFITS:
  - Maintenance allowance: ₹1,200–₹1,600 per month depending on course level.
  - Tuition fee reimbursement as per actual (for government recognized institutions).
  - Book allowance, study tour, thesis allowance for certain courses.
  - Additional allowance for students with disabilities.
  - Day scholars and hostellers have different rates.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via NSP and State Portals

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Register on www.scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar.
  Step 2: Select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students'.
  Step 3: Fill personal, academic, and bank details.
  Step 4: Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and other documents.
  Step 5: Submit the form and await institute-level verification.
  Step 6: State government verifies and releases funds via DBT.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Caste Certificate (SC)
  - Income Certificate (below ₹2.5 lakh)
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Last qualifying exam marksheet
  - Bank account passbook
  - Current year admission receipt/fee receipt
  - Bonafide certificate from institution
  - Domicile/Residence Certificate
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: All eligible SC applicants satisfying income and category criteria are selected. No competitive exam required. Document verification is the selection process.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual renewal. Student must pass the previous year exam. Fresh income certificate required each year. Renewal done on NSP portal.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: July (annually)
  Last Date: November 30 (typically, varies by state)
  Renewal Deadline: October–November

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://scholarships.gov.in | https://socialjustice.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: Ministry Helpline: 011-23381010 | NSP: 0120-6619540
SOURCE: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, NSP
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Is there a mark/merit requirement?
  A1: No minimum marks are required. Only caste and income criteria apply.
  Q2: Can students in private colleges apply?
  A2: Yes, if the institution is recognized by UGC/AICTE/State government.
  Q3: Is PhD level covered?
  A3: Yes, post-matric scholarship covers up to PhD level.
  Q4: What is the income limit?
  A4: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh per annum.
  Q5: Can Aadhaar be of father or mother?
  A5: No, the scholarship applicant must have their own Aadhaar linked to their bank account.
  Q6: Are distance education students eligible?
  A6: Generally no; this scheme is for regular/full-time students only.
  Q7: How long does it take to receive money?
  A7: Typically 3–6 months after form submission and verification.
  Q8: Can I apply from a different state than my domicile?
  A8: Some states allow this; check your state-specific rules.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Income exceeds ₹2.5 lakh
  - Non-SC category
  - Duplicate application
  - Institution not recognized
  - Aadhaar mismatch
  - Incomplete documents

SCHEME: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Education)
SCHEME ID: SCH-003
CATEGORY: Scholarship / Women Empowerment / Technical Education
PROVIDED BY: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Girl students enrolled in AICTE-approved Diploma or Degree (First Year) programs
SUMMARY: Pragati Scholarship is awarded by AICTE to encourage girl students to pursue technical education. It provides financial support to cover tuition and living expenses for girl students from low-income families enrolled in AICTE-approved institutions.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Promote technical education among girl students.
  - Reduce financial barriers for girls in engineering and technology.
  - Increase female enrollment in AICTE-approved institutions.
  - Support one girl per family principle for equitable access.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Only girl students are eligible.
  - Must be admitted in First Year of AICTE-approved Degree or Diploma program.
  - Annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh.
  - Only one girl child per family is eligible (if two girls, one of them can apply).
  - Must not be availing any other AICTE scholarship simultaneously.
  - Lateral entry (2nd year) students are not eligible in first year intake.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹30,000 per year for tuition and other fees.
  - ₹2,000 per month incidental charges (10 months = ₹20,000 per year).
  - Total benefit: up to ₹50,000 per academic year.
  - 4,000 scholarships awarded nationally every year.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via AICTE portal

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit www.aicte-india.org or NSP portal.
  Step 2: Register as new user using mobile/email and Aadhaar.
  Step 3: Select 'Pragati Scholarship for Girls'.
  Step 4: Fill academic and family income details.
  Step 5: Upload all required documents.
  Step 6: Submit and track application status online.
  Step 7: After verification, amount credited via DBT.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Income Certificate (below ₹8 lakh, from competent authority)
  - Class 10 and 12 marksheets
  - College admission proof / fee receipt
  - Bank passbook (student's own account)
  - Photograph
  - Domicile Certificate

SELECTION PROCESS: First-come, first-served within merit-cum-means basis. 4,000 slots nationally. Early application is recommended.
RENEWAL RULES: Renewable for duration of course. Must pass every year exam. Income certificate and fresh application required annually.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: August–September (annually)
  Last Date: October (typically)
  Renewal Deadline: October

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://www.aicte-india.org | https://scholarships.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: AICTE Helpdesk: 011-29581000 | pragati@aicte-india.org
SOURCE: AICTE Official Portal, Ministry of Education
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can diploma students apply?
  A1: Yes, both diploma and degree (BTech/BE) first-year girl students can apply.
  Q2: Is there an income limit?
  A2: Yes, annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh.
  Q3: Can I apply in second year?
  A3: No, only first-year admissions are eligible. Lateral entry students cannot apply.
  Q4: Are private engineering colleges included?
  A4: Yes, if the college is AICTE-approved.
  Q5: How many scholarships are given each year?
  A5: 4,000 scholarships are distributed nationally.
  Q6: Is this scholarship taxable?
  A6: Scholarships are generally exempt from income tax in India.
  Q7: Can two sisters from same family apply?
  A7: Only one girl child per family is eligible at a time.
  Q8: Is there a minimum marks requirement?
  A8: No minimum marks, but income and AICTE-approved enrollment are mandatory.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Male student applied
  - Income above ₹8 lakh
  - Not enrolled in AICTE-approved institution
  - Lateral entry / second year applicant
  - Incomplete documents
  - Two girls from same family both applied

SCHEME: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
SCHEME ID: SCH-004
CATEGORY: Scholarship / Disability Support / Technical Education
PROVIDED BY: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Students with special abilities (disability) in AICTE-approved technical programs
SUMMARY: AICTE Saksham Scholarship is designed for specially-abled students pursuing technical education in AICTE-approved institutions. It provides financial assistance to help them pursue their degree or diploma without financial stress.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Support differently-abled students in pursuing technical education.
  - Remove financial barriers for students with disabilities.
  - Promote inclusive education in technical institutions.
  - Cover tuition and living expenses for specially-abled students.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be a specially-abled (disabled) student with a minimum 40% disability.
  - Must be enrolled in First Year of AICTE-approved Degree or Diploma program.
  - Annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh.
  - Must have a valid Disability Certificate from a competent medical authority.
  - Not availing any other AICTE scholarship simultaneously.
  - Both male and female students are eligible.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹30,000 per year for tuition and other fees.
  - ₹2,000 per month incidental charges (10 months).
  - Total benefit: up to ₹50,000 per academic year.
  - 2,000 scholarships awarded nationally per year.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via AICTE Portal / NSP

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit www.aicte-india.org or NSP portal.
  Step 2: Register using Aadhaar and mobile number.
  Step 3: Select 'Saksham Scholarship'.
  Step 4: Fill in disability details, academic details, and income details.
  Step 5: Upload Disability Certificate and other documents.
  Step 6: Submit and track status.
  Step 7: Amount credited to bank account via DBT.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Disability Certificate (40% or more, issued by government medical board)
  - Income Certificate (below ₹8 lakh)
  - Class 10 and 12 marksheets
  - College admission receipt
  - Bank passbook
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: Based on disability criteria and income. 2,000 slots nationally. Merit-cum-means basis.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual renewal. Must pass exams and resubmit income certificate.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: August–September (annually)
  Last Date: October (typically)
  Renewal Deadline: October

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://www.aicte-india.org
OFFICIAL CONTACT: AICTE Helpdesk: 011-29581000
SOURCE: AICTE Official Portal
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: What percentage of disability is required?
  A1: Minimum 40% disability is required.
  Q2: Can students with visual impairment apply?
  A2: Yes, all types of recognized disabilities are eligible.
  Q3: Is there a merit requirement?
  A3: No minimum marks are required.
  Q4: Can this be combined with state disability scholarship?
  A4: Generally no – cannot avail two AICTE scholarships simultaneously.
  Q5: Are diploma students eligible?
  A5: Yes, both diploma and degree first-year students are eligible.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Disability below 40%
  - Invalid or expired disability certificate
  - Income above ₹8 lakh
  - Not enrolled in AICTE-approved institution
  - Already availing another AICTE scholarship

SCHEME: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Central Armed Police Forces and Railways
SCHEME ID: SCH-005
CATEGORY: Scholarship / Education Assistance
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Home Affairs / Railway Board
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Dependent wards and widows of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs), RPF, and Railway personnel
SUMMARY: PM Scholarship Scheme provides financial scholarships to dependent wards and widows of CAPF, RPF, and Railway personnel to pursue higher education in professional courses like engineering, medicine, MBA, MCA, and others.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Encourage higher education among wards of CAPF and Railway personnel.
  - Provide financial support to families of deceased/disabled paramilitary personnel.
  - Support professional education in technical and non-technical courses.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Ward or widow of ex-CAPF, RPF, or Railway personnel.
  - Priority to wards of personnel killed/disabled in duty.
  - Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying examination (Class 12).
  - Enrolled in first year of professional degree course (MBBS, BDS, BPharma, BTech, BBA, MBA, MCA, etc.).
  - Age limit: 18–25 years.
  - Income: No specific income limit but priority to low-income families.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹2,500 per month for male students.
  - ₹3,000 per month for female students.
  - Renewable for duration of course (up to 5 years).
  - Disbursed via DBT.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via KSB Portal / NSP

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit ksb.gov.in or scholarships.gov.in.
  Step 2: Register using Aadhaar and contact details.
  Step 3: Select PMSS scheme and fill application.
  Step 4: Upload service documents of parent/guardian and other proof.
  Step 5: Submit and await verification.
  Step 6: Scholarship disbursed after approval.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Service/PPO certificate of parent/guardian (CAPF/Railway)
  - Death/disability certificate (if applicable)
  - Class 12 marksheet (60%+)
  - College admission proof
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank passbook
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: Priority given to wards of personnel killed/disabled in duty. Remaining selected on merit (marks in qualifying exam).
RENEWAL RULES: Annual renewal. Must pass each year. Fresh application each year on KSB portal.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: June–July (annually)
  Last Date: October (typically)

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://ksb.gov.in | https://scholarships.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: KSB Helpline: 011-26715250
SOURCE: Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Ministry of Home Affairs
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Are children of serving personnel eligible?
  A1: Yes, both serving and ex-service personnel's wards are eligible.
  Q2: Is there a minimum income criteria?
  A2: No income limit, but priority given to lower-income families.
  Q3: Can wards of state police apply?
  A3: No, only Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) and Railways are covered.
  Q4: Is this for professional courses only?
  A4: Yes, only recognized professional degree programs are included.
  Q5: How many scholarships are given?
  A5: Around 5,500 scholarships are given annually under the CAPF component.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Marks below 60% in qualifying exam
  - Non-professional course selected
  - Incorrect service documentation
  - Age above 25 years
  - Not ward of eligible personnel

SCHEME: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) Scheme
SCHEME ID: WOM-001
CATEGORY: Women Empowerment / Child Welfare / Education
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Ministry of Education
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (focused on districts with low Sex Ratio at Birth)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Girl children, women, communities with adverse sex ratio
SUMMARY: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is a tri-ministry initiative to address declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) in India, prevent gender-biased sex-selective elimination, ensure survival, protection, and education of the girl child.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Prevent gender-biased sex-selective elimination.
  - Ensure survival and protection of the girl child.
  - Promote education and participation of girls in society.
  - Sensitize communities on gender equality.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All girl children, especially in districts with low sex ratio.
  - Families with newborn/young girl children.
  - Schools and community organizations can avail awareness programs.
  - Not a direct cash benefit scheme – mostly awareness-based.

BENEFITS:
  - Awareness and community mobilization programs.
  - Incentives for girls' education in partner states.
  - Convergence with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana for financial benefits.
  - School enrollment drives and awareness campaigns.
  - Rewards and recognition for districts improving sex ratio.

APPLICATION MODE: Community Program – No direct application required

APPLICATION STEPS:
  For Sukanya Samriddhi: Open account at post office or bank.
  For school enrollment support: Contact local Anganwadi or ASHA worker.
  For community awareness: Contact district WCD office.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Birth certificate of girl child (for Sukanya Samriddhi component)
  - Parent's Aadhaar and address proof
  - Bank/Post Office passbook for Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana

SELECTION PROCESS: Not applicable – community program. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is open to all girl children below 10 years.
RENEWAL RULES: Sukanya Samriddhi Account continues until maturity (21 years from opening).

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: January 22, 2015
  Ongoing: Active scheme

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://wcd.nic.in | https://betibachaobetipadhao.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: WCD Ministry: 011-23073303
SOURCE: Ministry of Women and Child Development
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Is there direct cash benefit?
  A1: BBBP itself is awareness-based. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana under BBBP gives financial benefits.
  Q2: What is Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana?
  A2: A savings scheme with high interest rate (8.2% in 2025) for girl children below 10 years.
  Q3: Can boys apply for Sukanya Samriddhi?
  A3: No, only girl children are eligible.
  Q4: Till what age can account be opened?
  A4: Girl child must be below 10 years of age at account opening.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Girl child above 10 years (for Sukanya Samriddhi)
  - Incomplete birth certificate

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
SCHEME ID: WOM-002
CATEGORY: Women Welfare / Maternity Benefit / Health
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Women and Child Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Pregnant and lactating women (first living child)
SUMMARY: PMMVY is a maternity benefit program that provides partial wage compensation to pregnant and lactating women to enable them to take adequate rest before and after delivery of the first living child. Also encourages safe delivery and breastfeeding.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide partial compensation for wage loss during pregnancy and lactation.
  - Promote better health-seeking behaviour among pregnant women.
  - Improve health and nutrition of mother and child.
  - Reduce maternal and infant mortality.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All pregnant and lactating women, 19 years of age or above.
  - Applicable for first living child birth.
  - Women who are employed with central/state government or public sector undertakings not eligible (already covered by maternity benefit act).
  - Women who had stillbirth: can claim for subsequent pregnancy.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹5,000 direct cash transfer in three instalments:
  -   - Instalment 1: ₹1,000 – on early registration of pregnancy at Anganwadi
  -   - Instalment 2: ₹2,000 – on completion of at least one ANC (Antenatal Checkup)
  -   - Instalment 3: ₹2,000 – after child birth registration and first cycle of vaccination
  - Additional ₹1,000 for institutional delivery through Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
  - Effectively ₹6,000 benefit for eligible women delivering at government facilities.

APPLICATION MODE: Offline at Anganwadi Centre or online via PMMVY-CAS portal

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or health facility.
  Step 2: Fill Form 1A for first instalment with LMP date and ANC registration.
  Step 3: Fill Form 1B for second instalment after ANC checkup.
  Step 4: Fill Form 1C for third instalment after child birth and vaccination.
  Step 5: Submit Aadhaar and bank details for DBT.
  Step 6: Amount directly transferred to mother's bank account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card of mother
  - Bank passbook (mother's account)
  - MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card
  - Proof of pregnancy registration
  - Vaccination records for third instalment

SELECTION PROCESS: Entitlement-based – all eligible pregnant women can apply. No competitive selection.
RENEWAL RULES: Not renewable – one-time benefit for first living child.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: January 1, 2017
  Ongoing: Active scheme

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://wcd.nic.in/pmmvy | https://pmmvy-cas.nic.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: WCD Ministry: 011-23073303 | PMMVY helpline: 7998799804
SOURCE: Ministry of Women and Child Development
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Is this for all children or only first child?
  A1: Currently only for the first living child.
  Q2: If first child was stillbirth, can I claim for second pregnancy?
  A2: Yes, in case of stillbirth or miscarriage you can claim for next pregnancy.
  Q3: Is Aadhaar mandatory?
  A3: Yes, Aadhaar is required for DBT transfer.
  Q4: What is the total cash benefit?
  A4: ₹5,000 from PMMVY plus ₹1,000 from JSY = ₹6,000 for institutional delivery.
  Q5: Can working women apply?
  A5: Yes, unless employed under central/state government with maternity benefits.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Already availing government maternity benefit
  - Application for second child
  - No Aadhaar linked bank account
  - Incomplete ANC registration

SCHEME: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
SCHEME ID: FARM-001
CATEGORY: Farmer Welfare / Financial Assistance
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Small and marginal landholding farmers with cultivable land
SUMMARY: PM-KISAN provides income support of ₹6,000 per year in three instalments to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for purchasing inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and meeting other cultivation needs.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Supplement income of small and marginal farmers.
  - Provide financial support for agricultural inputs.
  - Reduce farmer indebtedness.
  - Improve farmers' financial resilience.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Landholding farmer family (husband, wife, minor children) with cultivable agricultural land.
  - No upper limit on land holding (extended from small/marginal farmers to all farmers in 2019).
  - Must have land records in their name.
  - Exclusions: Income Tax payers, current/former constitutional post holders, government employees (except multi-task workers/Group D), professionals like doctors and engineers.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000 each.
  - Directly credited to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
  - Installments transferred in April–July, August–November, December–March.

APPLICATION MODE: Online at pmkisan.gov.in / through Common Service Centre (CSC) / through local patwari

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit pmkisan.gov.in.
  Step 2: Click 'Farmer Corner' > 'New Farmer Registration'.
  Step 3: Enter Aadhaar number, bank account number, and land details.
  Step 4: Verify mobile OTP.
  Step 5: Complete registration with land records (Khasra/Khatauni).
  Step 6: Verification done by state/district-level officials.
  Step 7: After approval, instalments credited to bank account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Land records (Khasra/Khatauni/Jamabandi)
  - Bank account passbook
  - Mobile number

SELECTION PROCESS: Entitlement-based. All eligible landholding farmer families are entitled to receive benefit.
RENEWAL RULES: Automatic – reinstalment continues as long as farmer remains eligible and land records are valid.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: February 24, 2019
  Ongoing: Active – instalments released every 4 months

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://pmkisan.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PM-KISAN Helpline: 155261 / 011-24300606 | pmkisan-ict@gov.in
SOURCE: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, pmkisan.gov.in
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: What if I don't have Aadhaar?
  A1: Aadhaar is mandatory for registration and DBT transfer.
  Q2: Can tenant farmers apply?
  A2: No, the land must be in the farmer's name in land records.
  Q3: How to check instalment status?
  A3: Visit pmkisan.gov.in > Farmer Corner > Beneficiary Status.
  Q4: What if instalment is not received?
  A4: Contact PM-KISAN helpline at 155261 or visit nearest CSC.
  Q5: Can farmer's wife register separately?
  A5: No, only one registration per family (husband-wife-minor children).
  Q6: Is there income limit?
  A6: No income limit, but income tax payers are excluded.
  Q7: How many instalments per year?
  A7: Three instalments of ₹2,000 each = ₹6,000 per year.
  Q8: Can a farmer with less than 2 acres land apply?
  A8: Yes, all landholding farmers regardless of land size can apply.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Farmer is income tax payer
  - No land in farmer's name
  - Duplicate application
  - Aadhaar-bank account not linked
  - Land records mismatch

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
SCHEME ID: FARM-002
CATEGORY: Farmer Welfare / Crop Insurance / Agriculture
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Farmers growing notified food crops, oilseeds, and horticultural crops
SUMMARY: PMFBY provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage to farmers for financial support against crop loss/damage due to natural calamities, pests and diseases. Premium is subsidized heavily by central and state governments.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage.
  - Stabilize income of farmers to ensure their continuity in farming.
  - Encourage farmers to adopt innovative and modern agricultural practices.
  - Ensure flow of credit to the agriculture sector.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
  - Loanee farmers: Mandatory for those taking crop loans (KCC holders).
  - Non-loanee farmers: Voluntary enrollment.
  - Both landowners and tenant/sharecropper farmers can apply.
  - Must be cultivating notified crops in the enrolled season.

BENEFITS:
  - Comprehensive risk coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
  - Premium rates: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
  - Balance premium paid by central and state governments.
  - Sum insured based on scale of finance (typically equal to cost of cultivation).
  - Payout in case of crop failure due to drought, flood, pest attack, etc.
  - Use of technology (satellite, drone) for faster claim settlement.

APPLICATION MODE: Online (pmfby.gov.in / CSC) and Offline (through bank/insurance company)

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit pmfby.gov.in or nearest CSC/bank.
  Step 2: Enroll with land records, crop details, and Aadhaar.
  Step 3: Pay subsidized premium amount.
  Step 4: Receive policy document.
  Step 5: In case of crop loss, file claim within 72 hours at nearest bank/insurance company.
  Step 6: Claim assessed via field survey or technology-based assessment.
  Step 7: Amount credited directly to bank account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Land records (7/12 extract or Khasra)
  - Bank passbook
  - Crop sowing certificate (if non-loanee)
  - KCC details (for loanee farmers)

SELECTION PROCESS: Entitlement-based for notified crops. All eligible farmers in notified area can enroll.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual enrollment each season (Kharif and Rabi).

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Kharif Deadline: July 31 (approximately)
  Rabi Deadline: December 31 (approximately)
  Ongoing: Active scheme

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://pmfby.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PMFBY Helpline: 1800-180-1551
SOURCE: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, pmfby.gov.in
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Is premium fully free?
  A1: No, farmers pay 2% for Kharif and 1.5% for Rabi. Government pays the rest.
  Q2: What calamities are covered?
  A2: Drought, flood, unseasonal rainfall, hailstorm, cyclone, pest attack, disease.
  Q3: Can tenant farmers enroll?
  A3: Yes, tenant and sharecropper farmers can enroll.
  Q4: How to file a claim?
  A4: Inform bank or insurance company within 72 hours of crop loss.
  Q5: How soon is claim settled?
  A5: Typically within 2 months of crop cutting data being available.
  Q6: Are all crops covered?
  A6: Only notified crops in notified areas are covered.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Crop not in notified list
  - Area not notified
  - Enrollment after deadline
  - Incorrect land records
  - Claim not filed within 72 hours

SCHEME: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
SCHEME ID: HLTH-001
CATEGORY: Healthcare / Insurance
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (except some states with own schemes)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Bottom 40% of Indian population – poor and vulnerable families as per SECC 2011
SUMMARY: PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health insurance scheme providing coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization. Previously known as Ayushman Bharat Yojana.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide financial protection against catastrophic health expenditure.
  - Enable poor families to access quality secondary and tertiary healthcare.
  - Reduce out-of-pocket health expenses for the poor.
  - Improve health outcomes for vulnerable populations.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Families listed in Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database.
  - Automatically covered if listed in SECC – no income proof required.
  - Construction workers, street vendors, rickshaw pullers, rag pickers, domestic helpers, sanitation workers, home-based workers, artisans, and other specified occupational groups.
  - Families in rural areas with specific deprivation parameters.
  - No cap on family size – entire family is covered.
  - Pre-existing diseases are covered from Day 1.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year.
  - Covers hospitalization expenses including pre and post hospitalization.
  - Over 1,929 treatment packages and procedures covered.
  - Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals (government and private).
  - Pre-existing conditions covered.
  - No cap on family size.
  - Transportation allowance included.

APPLICATION MODE: No application needed – entitlement-based. Verify eligibility and get card.

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555.
  Step 2: If eligible, visit nearest CSC or empanelled hospital.
  Step 3: Show Aadhaar/ration card for identification.
  Step 4: Generate Ayushman Bharat Card (Golden Card) free of cost.
  Step 5: Use card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card (or any ID to establish SECC identity)
  - Ration Card (for rural SECC families)
  - Mobile number for OTP

SELECTION PROCESS: SECC 2011 data-based entitlement. If family appears in SECC, they are automatically eligible.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual card renewal. Coverage renews every year automatically.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: September 23, 2018
  Ongoing: Active scheme

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://pmjay.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PM-JAY Helpline: 14555 / 1800-111-565
SOURCE: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: How do I know if I am eligible?
  A1: Visit pmjay.gov.in and search by Aadhaar or ration card number, or call 14555.
  Q2: Are private hospitals covered?
  A2: Yes, over 25,000+ empanelled hospitals, both government and private.
  Q3: Is pre-existing disease covered?
  A3: Yes, from the very first day.
  Q4: Can I use it in another state?
  A4: Yes, it is portable across India at any empanelled hospital.
  Q5: Is childbirth covered?
  A5: Yes, maternity and newborn care are covered.
  Q6: What is the ₹5 lakh limit – per person or per family?
  A6: It is per family per year, shared among all family members.
  Q7: What if I'm not in SECC list but am poor?
  A7: Contact state government – some states have expanded coverage.
  Q8: Can a senior citizen apply?
  A8: Yes, if family is in SECC list. Additionally, Ayushman Vaya Vandana now covers all senior citizens 70+.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Family not in SECC 2011
  - Aadhaar mismatch
  - Hospital not empanelled
  - Treatment package not covered

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) Pension Scheme
SCHEME ID: PEN-001
CATEGORY: Pension / Senior Citizen Welfare / Unorganized Workers
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Labour and Employment
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Unorganized sector workers with monthly income up to ₹15,000
SUMMARY: PM-SYM is a voluntary pension scheme for unorganized workers like street vendors, rickshaw pullers, construction workers, cobblers, rag pickers, domestic helpers, and similar low-income workers. Provides assured pension of ₹3,000/month after age 60.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide old-age financial security to unorganized workers.
  - Enable low-income workers to save for retirement.
  - Government co-contribution encourages enrollment.
  - Cover the 40+ crore unorganized sector workforce.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Age: 18–40 years at the time of enrollment.
  - Monthly income must not exceed ₹15,000.
  - Must not be covered under any other pension scheme (NPS, EPFO, ESIC).
  - Must not be an income tax payer.
  - Must be in unorganized sector employment.
  - Must have a savings bank account and Aadhaar number.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60.
  - Government contributes equal amount as the subscriber.
  - Monthly contribution: ₹55–₹200 depending on age at enrollment.
  - If subscriber dies before 60: spouse can continue or withdraw.
  - If subscriber dies after 60: spouse gets 50% as family pension.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via maandhan.in or through CSC

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit maandhan.in or nearest CSC.
  Step 2: Register using Aadhaar and savings account details.
  Step 3: Choose entry age and verify monthly contribution.
  Step 4: Contribution auto-debited from savings account monthly.
  Step 5: Government credits equal contribution monthly.
  Step 6: At age 60, start receiving ₹3,000/month pension.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Savings Bank Account passbook
  - Mobile number

SELECTION PROCESS: Voluntary enrollment – no competitive selection. All eligible can join.
RENEWAL RULES: Monthly contribution must be maintained. No separate renewal needed.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: February 2019
  Ongoing: Active scheme

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://maandhan.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PM-SYM Helpline: 1800-267-6888
SOURCE: Ministry of Labour and Employment, maandhan.in
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can a vegetable vendor apply?
  A1: Yes, all unorganized workers with income under ₹15,000/month can apply.
  Q2: What if I miss a monthly payment?
  A2: Account can be regularized with penalty. Continued non-payment may suspend account.
  Q3: Can EPFO member apply?
  A3: No, those already covered by EPFO, NPS, or ESIC are not eligible.
  Q4: What is government's contribution?
  A4: Government matches the subscriber's contribution exactly.
  Q5: Can I exit before age 60?
  A5: Yes, you get back contributions with savings bank interest if exit before 10 years. After 10 years, NPS returns apply.
  Q6: Is nominee facility available?
  A6: Yes, you must nominate a family member.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Already in EPFO/NPS/ESIC
  - Income above ₹15,000/month
  - Age above 40 at enrollment
  - Income tax payer

SCHEME: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
SCHEME ID: PEN-002
CATEGORY: Pension / Social Security
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Finance / Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Indian citizens aged 18–40, primarily unorganized sector
SUMMARY: APY is a guaranteed pension scheme for citizens in the unorganized sector. Subscribers receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60, depending on their contribution amount and age of entry.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide social security and old-age income to all citizens.
  - Encourage savings habit among low-income and unorganized workers.
  - Cover citizens not under any organized pension scheme.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Indian citizen, aged 18–40 years.
  - Must have a bank account.
  - Not a taxpayer (income tax payers are excluded since October 2022).
  - Must not be a beneficiary of any social security scheme under EPF & MP Act.

BENEFITS:
  - Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month at age 60.
  - Minimum contribution: ₹42/month (for ₹1,000 pension at age 18 entry).
  - Maximum contribution: ₹1,454/month (for ₹5,000 pension at age 40 entry).
  - On death of subscriber: spouse gets same pension; on death of spouse, nominee gets corpus.
  - Government co-contributed 50% of subscriber's contribution or ₹1,000/year, whichever is lower, for 5 years (for non-taxpayer subscribers enrolled before March 2016).

APPLICATION MODE: Through banks, post offices, or APY mobile app

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit any bank branch or post office.
  Step 2: Fill APY registration form (APY-1).
  Step 3: Provide bank account, Aadhaar, and mobile number.
  Step 4: Select desired pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000).
  Step 5: Monthly contribution auto-debited from account.
  Step 6: At age 60, pension credited monthly.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank account passbook/details
  - Mobile number

SELECTION PROCESS: Voluntary enrollment. No selection criteria beyond eligibility.
RENEWAL RULES: Monthly auto-debit continues. Penalties apply for missed payments.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: June 1, 2015
  Ongoing: Active scheme

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://npscra.nsdl.co.in/scheme-details-apy.php | https://www.pfrda.org.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: APY Helpline: 1800-110-069 | PFRDA: 011-26514046
SOURCE: PFRDA, Ministry of Finance
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can a housewife apply?
  A1: Yes, any Indian citizen aged 18–40 with a bank account can apply.
  Q2: Is there a maximum pension limit?
  A2: Maximum guaranteed pension is ₹5,000/month.
  Q3: What happens if I miss payment?
  A3: Penalty of ₹1 per month per ₹100 of contribution applies.
  Q4: Can an NRI apply?
  A4: No, only resident Indian citizens are eligible.
  Q5: Can I increase my pension amount later?
  A5: Yes, you can upgrade once a year to a higher pension plan.
  Q6: Is income tax payer eligible?
  A6: No, income taxpayers are not eligible for APY since October 2022.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Age below 18 or above 40
  - No bank account
  - Income taxpayer
  - Already in organized pension scheme

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) 4.0
SCHEME ID: EMPL-001
CATEGORY: Skill Development / Employment
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship / National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Indian youth, school/college dropouts, unemployed graduates
SUMMARY: PMKVY is India's flagship skill development scheme that provides free short-term skill training to youth in market-relevant skills. Version 4.0 (2022–2026) focuses on Industry 4.0, AI, robotics, coding, and emerging technology skills.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Create skilled workforce aligned to industry requirements.
  - Provide certification and improve employability of youth.
  - Cover ITI/polytechnic dropouts and unemployed graduates.
  - Focus on future skills like AI, robotics, drone technology, green jobs.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Indian citizen.
  - Age: 15–45 years (varies by sector).
  - School/college dropout or unemployed individual.
  - No specific income limit.
  - No minimum educational qualification for most courses.
  - Classes available in multiple sectors: IT, construction, retail, beauty, agriculture, healthcare, etc.

BENEFITS:
  - Free skill training at Skill Training Centres (STC/PMKVY TC).
  - Industry-recognized certification upon completion.
  - Post-training placement assistance.
  - Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) for individuals with existing skills.
  - Monthly stipend during training in some courses.
  - Training in future skills: AI, ML, IoT, drone operation, coding.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via skillindiadigital.gov.in or visit nearest PMKVY Training Centre

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit skillindiadigital.gov.in.
  Step 2: Register as a candidate.
  Step 3: Search for available courses and training centres near you.
  Step 4: Enroll in desired course.
  Step 5: Attend training sessions.
  Step 6: Appear for assessment by SSC (Sector Skill Council).
  Step 7: Receive National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF) certificate.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank account passbook
  - Educational qualification certificate
  - Photograph
  - Caste/Category certificate (if applicable)

SELECTION PROCESS: First-come, first-served basis at training centres. No entrance exam.
RENEWAL RULES: Typically one course per candidate. Re-enrollment possible for different sectors.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Pmkvy 4 Timeline: 2022–2026

SCHEME: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
SCHEME ID: EMPL-002
CATEGORY: Rural Employment / Labour Welfare
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Rural Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (rural areas)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
SUMMARY: MGNREGA guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work. It is a rights-based wage employment program aimed at enhancing livelihood security in rural areas.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Guarantee 100 days of employment per household per year.
  - Enhance livelihood security in rural areas.
  - Create durable community assets like roads, ponds, wells.
  - Empower rural population, especially women and marginal communities.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Adult (18+) members of rural households.
  - Must be willing to do unskilled manual work.
  - Must reside in rural area (gram panchayat jurisdiction).
  - Must register at Gram Panchayat and possess Job Card.
  - Women get priority and 1/3rd of workers must be women.

BENEFITS:
  - Guaranteed 100 days of employment per household per year.
  - Minimum wage as per state notification (typically ₹200–₹350/day).
  - Payment within 15 days of work done, via bank/post office account.
  - If employment not provided within 15 days, unemployment allowance is paid.
  - Worksite facilities: drinking water, shade, crèche, first aid.

APPLICATION MODE: Offline at Gram Panchayat / Block Office

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit Gram Panchayat office.
  Step 2: Apply for Job Card (MGNREGA registration).
  Step 3: Job Card issued within 15 days.
  Step 4: Submit written demand for employment to GP.
  Step 5: Employment provided within 15 days of demand.
  Step 6: Wages paid within 15 days of work completion.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank account details (for DBT payment)
  - Photograph
  - Residence proof in rural area

SELECTION PROCESS: Rights-based – all eligible rural adults who demand employment must be given work.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual – Job Card is valid. Employment demand can be made any time during the year.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Enacted: September 7, 2005
  Ongoing: Active

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://nrega.nic.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: MGNREGA Helpline: 1800-345-22244
SOURCE: Ministry of Rural Development, nrega.nic.in
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: What if employment is not given in 15 days?
  A1: Unemployment allowance must be paid as per the Act.
  Q2: Are women given priority?
  A2: Yes, 1/3rd of workers must be women.
  Q3: Can urban workers apply?
  A3: No, only rural household members are eligible.
  Q4: What types of work are done?
  A4: Road construction, pond deepening, tree plantation, land development, water conservation works.
  Q5: Can a job card holder work in other states?
  A5: MGNREGA is local employment; you work in your gram panchayat area.
  Q6: Is there a maximum wage?
  A6: Wage varies by state minimum wage notification.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Applicant resides in urban area
  - Refusing unskilled work
  - No Job Card
  - Fraudulent multiple registration

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
SCHEME ID: HOUS-001
CATEGORY: Housing / Rural Development
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Rural Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (rural areas)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Homeless and kutcha/dilapidated house dwellers in rural areas (BPL/SECC families)
SUMMARY: PMAY-G aims to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to all eligible rural poor. Provides financial assistance to construct new houses or upgrade dilapidated homes. Target: Housing for All in rural India.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide pucca houses to all eligible rural households.
  - Improve living standards of rural poor.
  - Ensure access to basic amenities like toilet, electricity, drinking water.
  - Promote inclusive and sustainable rural development.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Households listed as houseless in SECC 2011 database.
  - Households with kutcha/dilapidated houses (0, 1, or 2 room pucca houses).
  - Priority to SC/ST, minorities, persons with disability, bonded labour.
  - No land ownership conflict.
  - Gram Sabha selection from SECC data.
  - Must not have any pucca house.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹1.20 lakh per house in plain areas (central + state share).
  - ₹1.30 lakh per house in hilly/difficult areas.
  - Toilet facility under Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM-G): ₹12,000 extra.
  - MGNREGA support for unskilled labor.
  - LPG connection under Ujjwala, electricity under SAUBHAGYA.
  - Payment in instalments via DBT directly to beneficiary's account.

APPLICATION MODE: Gram Sabha selection based on SECC data / Self-nomination at Gram Panchayat

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Check if your name is in SECC 2011 waitlist at your Gram Panchayat.
  Step 2: Gram Sabha verifies and approves the list.
  Step 3: Name forwarded to Block/District office.
  Step 4: Beneficiary receives approval and sanction letter.
  Step 5: Construction begins; instalment released on each stage.
  Step 6: Geo-tagged photos taken at each stage for verification.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank account passbook
  - SECC identification number
  - Land ownership proof (if applicable)
  - Job Card (MGNREGA)

SELECTION PROCESS: Based on SECC 2011 permanent waitlist, Gram Sabha verification, and priority criteria.
RENEWAL RULES: One-time benefit. Not renewable.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: November 2016
  Ongoing: Active – extended to 2024-25 with new targets

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://pmayg.nic.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PMAY-G Helpline: 1800-11-6446
SOURCE: Ministry of Rural Development, pmayg.nic.in
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: How do I know if my name is in the list?
  A1: Visit pmayg.nic.in and search by name, or check with Gram Panchayat.
  Q2: Can urban residents apply?
  A2: No, PMAY-G is only for rural areas. Urban residents apply under PMAY-U.
  Q3: Is there an income limit?
  A3: Selection is based on SECC deprivation parameters, not just income.
  Q4: What if I already have some pucca rooms?
  A4: Households with 0, 1, or 2 pucca rooms are eligible.
  Q5: How much time does construction take?
  A5: Beneficiary must complete construction within 12 months of sanction.
  Q6: Are toilets mandatory?
  A6: Yes, beneficiaries must construct toilets under SBM-G as part of the package.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Name not in SECC 2011
  - Already has pucca house
  - Land dispute
  - Urban resident
  - Duplicate registration

SCHEME: Startup India Scheme
SCHEME ID: STRT-001
CATEGORY: Startup Support / Entrepreneurship / Employment
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / DPIIT
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Startups (private limited company, partnership firm, or LLP) with innovative business idea
SUMMARY: Startup India is the Government of India's flagship initiative to build a robust startup ecosystem, promote innovation, and drive sustainable economic growth. Registered startups get tax exemptions, funding access, easier compliance, and mentorship.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Build a strong and inclusive startup ecosystem.
  - Promote innovation and entrepreneurship.
  - Provide regulatory and tax benefits to eligible startups.
  - Create employment through new venture creation.
  - Support startups in funding, mentorship, and market access.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be incorporated as Private Limited Company / Registered Partnership Firm / LLP.
  - Age of entity: Not more than 10 years from incorporation.
  - Annual turnover must not exceed ₹100 crore in any financial year since incorporation.
  - Entity must be working towards innovation, development, or improvement of products/processes/services.
  - Must have a scalable business model with high job creation potential.
  - Should not have been formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business.

BENEFITS:
  - Tax exemption on profits for 3 out of 10 years (Section 80-IAC).
  - Exemption from capital gains tax under certain conditions.
  - Self-certification for 9 labour and environmental laws.
  - Fast-track patent examination with 80% rebate on fees.
  - Exemption from Angel Tax (Section 56(2)(viib)).
  - Access to Government e-Marketplace (GeM) for procurement.
  - ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS) via SIDBI.
  - Startup India Learning Program (free online courses).
  - Global market access and networking opportunities.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via startupindia.gov.in

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Incorporate your company as Pvt Ltd / LLP / Partnership.
  Step 2: Visit startupindia.gov.in and click 'Register'.
  Step 3: Sign up using company PAN and details.
  Step 4: Fill startup registration form with business details.
  Step 5: Upload incorporation certificate, PAN, and business brief.
  Step 6: Self-certify eligibility conditions.
  Step 7: DPIIT recognition certificate issued (usually within 2–3 days).
  Step 8: Apply for tax exemptions and other benefits separately.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Incorporation Certificate
  - PAN of entity
  - GST registration (if applicable)
  - Brief description of innovative nature of business
  - Website/pitch deck (optional but helpful)

SELECTION PROCESS: All eligible entities satisfying criteria get DPIIT recognition automatically.
RENEWAL RULES: Recognition is permanent. Tax benefits require fresh application each year.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: January 16, 2016
  Ongoing: Active

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://startupindia.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: Startup India Helpline: 011-44732000 | dipp-startups@nic.in
SOURCE: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can a sole proprietor register?
  A1: No, must be Pvt Ltd, LLP, or registered partnership. Sole proprietorship not eligible.
  Q2: Is there a minimum capital requirement?
  A2: No minimum capital requirement.
  Q3: Can a startup be in any sector?
  A3: Yes, any sector – technology, agriculture, healthcare, education, etc.
  Q4: What is DPIIT recognition?
  A4: Official government recognition of your entity as a startup, unlocking various benefits.
  Q5: Can a 5-year-old company register?
  A5: Yes, if within 10 years of incorporation and turnover under ₹100 crore.
  Q6: Is this different from MSME registration?
  A6: Yes, Startup India and MSME are separate registrations with different benefits. Both can be availed.
  Q7: How long does recognition take?
  A7: Usually 2–3 business days after document verification.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Entity older than 10 years
  - Turnover above ₹100 crore
  - Non-innovative or purely trading business
  - Split from existing company
  - Not incorporated as eligible entity type

SCHEME: Stand-Up India Scheme (Loans for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs)
SCHEME ID: SCST-001
CATEGORY: SC/ST Welfare / Women Empowerment / Entrepreneurship
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Finance / Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: SC, ST, or Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises
SUMMARY: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to SC, ST, and women borrowers for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sectors.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Facilitate credit for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
  - Promote entrepreneurship among marginalized communities.
  - Enable setting up of new enterprises in manufacturing, services, and trading.
  - Create at least one SC/ST and one women entrepreneur per bank branch.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be SC, ST, or woman entrepreneur.
  - Age 18 years and above.
  - Setting up a greenfield enterprise (new business, not an expansion).
  - In non-individual enterprise: at least 51% shareholding by SC/ST/women borrower.
  - Not in default to any bank or financial institution.
  - Business must be in manufacturing, services, or trading sector.

BENEFITS:
  - Composite loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore.
  - Working capital component included.
  - Loan repayment period: up to 7 years with 18-month moratorium.
  - Collateral security may be covered by Credit Guarantee Fund (NCGTC).
  - Interest rate at base rate + 3% + tenor premium (competitive).
  - Handholding support from bank/partner agencies.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via standupmitra.in or through bank branches

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit standupmitra.in and register.
  Step 2: Fill loan application form with business plan details.
  Step 3: Connect with nearest bank branch or get referred by portal.
  Step 4: Submit business plan, KYC, and documents.
  Step 5: Bank processes loan application.
  Step 6: Loan disbursed upon approval.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
  - Caste Certificate (for SC/ST)
  - Business plan / Project report
  - Bank account details
  - Proof of no default (CIBIL report)
  - Address proof
  - ITR (if applicable)

SELECTION PROCESS: Application-based. Evaluated on business viability and eligibility.
RENEWAL RULES: Loan is one-time. Renewal as per standard loan repayment terms.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: April 5, 2016
  Ongoing: Active

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://www.standupmitra.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: Stand Up India Helpline: 1800-180-1111 | SIDBI: 0522-2288547
SOURCE: SIDBI / Department of Financial Services
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can women from general category apply?
  A1: Yes, women from any caste/category can apply.
  Q2: Is this a grant or loan?
  A2: This is a loan, not a grant. Must be repaid.
  Q3: Can I apply for a second loan?
  A3: Typically one loan per eligible borrower under this scheme.
  Q4: Is there a subsidy?
  A4: No direct subsidy, but competitive interest rates and credit guarantee support.
  Q5: Can I use it for an existing business?
  A5: No, only greenfield (new) enterprises are eligible.
  Q6: What is the minimum loan amount?
  A6: ₹10 lakh minimum.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Not SC/ST or woman entrepreneur
  - Existing business (not greenfield)
  - Default in previous loan
  - Inadequate business plan
  - Loan above ₹1 crore

SCHEME: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students
SCHEME ID: MIN-001
CATEGORY: Scholarship / Minority Welfare
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Minority Affairs
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Minority community students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Zoroastrian, Jain) studying in Class 1 to 10
SUMMARY: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities provides financial assistance to minority community students studying in Class 1 to Class 10 to prevent dropout and promote education among minority communities.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Reduce dropout rate among minority students.
  - Provide financial support for elementary and secondary education.
  - Improve educational attainment of minority communities.
  - Ensure equal educational opportunities.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must belong to minority community: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Zoroastrian, or Jain.
  - Must be studying in Class 1 to 10.
  - Annual family income must not exceed ₹1 lakh.
  - Must have secured at least 50% marks in previous class exam.
  - Must be enrolled in a government or recognized private school.
  - Not availing any other scholarship from government sources.

BENEFITS:
  - Day scholars: ₹1,000 per year maintenance + admission/tuition fee up to ₹500/year.
  - Hostellers: ₹3,000 per year maintenance + admission/tuition fee.
  - Rates vary by class level (Class 1–5, 6–8, 9–10 have different rates).
  - Directly transferred to student's bank account.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and state portals

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit scholarships.gov.in.
  Step 2: Register with Aadhaar and mobile.
  Step 3: Select 'Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities'.
  Step 4: Fill school details, family income, and religion.
  Step 5: Upload minority certificate, income certificate, and marksheet.
  Step 6: Submit and await verification by school and state.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Minority community certificate
  - Income certificate (below ₹1 lakh)
  - Previous class marksheet (50%+)
  - Bonafide certificate from school
  - Bank passbook (student's or parent's)
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: Merit-cum-means. Prioritizes lower income within eligible group. Up to 30% of selected scholars should be girls.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual renewal with fresh income certificate and marksheet.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: July–August (annually)
  Last Date: October–November (varies by state)

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://scholarships.gov.in | https://minorityaffairs.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: Ministry of Minority Affairs: 011-23388202 | NSP: 0120-6619540
SOURCE: Ministry of Minority Affairs, National Scholarship Portal
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Which religions are covered as minority?
  A1: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Zoroastrian (Parsi), and Jain.
  Q2: Is 50% marks required?
  A2: Yes, must have 50% or more in previous year exam.
  Q3: Can I apply in Class 10?
  A3: Yes, Class 10 students are eligible.
  Q4: What is the income limit?
  A4: Annual family income must be below ₹1 lakh.
  Q5: Are madrasas eligible?
  A5: Yes, students in recognized madrasas can apply.
  Q6: Is this same as NSP minority scholarship?
  A6: Yes, this is administered through NSP.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Marks below 50%
  - Income above ₹1 lakh
  - Not a recognized minority religion
  - Duplicate scholarship from another source
  - Unrecognized institution

SUMMARY: NHFDC provides financial assistance through loans and scholarships to persons with disabilities for self-employment, skill development, higher education, and micro-financing to improve their economic status.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide financial support for education and self-employment to PwD.
  - Promote rehabilitation and mainstreaming of differently-abled persons.

  - For scholarships: pursuing graduate or higher technical/professional education.
  - For loans: any PwD above 18 years for self-employment.
  - Annual family income: below ₹3 lakh for scholarships.

  - Scholarship of ₹3,000–₹8,000 per month for PG courses.
  - Loans for self-employment up to ₹20 lakh.
  - Soft loans for assistive devices (wheelchair, hearing aid, etc.).
  - Skill development training programs.

APPLICATION MODE: Through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) and state NHFDC offices

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Contact nearest State Channelizing Agency (SCA) in your state.
  Step 2: Collect and fill application form.
  Step 3: Submit with disability certificate, income certificate, and education documents.
  Step 4: SCA verifies and forwards to NHFDC.
  Step 5: Loan/scholarship sanctioned and disbursed.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Disability Certificate (40%+)
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Income Certificate
  - Educational certificates
  - Bank passbook
  - Business plan (for self-employment loans)

SELECTION PROCESS: Priority based on income level and disability percentage.

SCHEME TYPE: Central Government

SCHEME: Epass Karnataka – Electronic Payment and Application System for Scholarships
SCHEME ID: KA-002
CATEGORY: Scholarship / Karnataka State Scheme
PROVIDED BY: Government of Karnataka – Backward Classes Welfare Department / SC/ST Welfare
SCHEME TYPE: State Government
APPLICABLE STATES: Karnataka
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: SC, ST, OBC, EBC, minority students studying in Karnataka
SUMMARY: Epass Karnataka is the state government portal for processing post-matric scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and Economically Backward students in Karnataka. All scholarship applications are processed digitally through this platform.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Digitize scholarship disbursement for backward class students in Karnataka.
  - Ensure transparency and reduce delays in scholarship payment.
  - Centralize all state scholarship schemes on one platform.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be a resident of Karnataka.
  - Must belong to SC, ST, OBC (Category I, IIA, IIB, IIIA, IIIB), Minority, or EBC category.
  - Studying in post-matric courses in Karnataka institutions.
  - Income criteria vary by scheme and category.
  - For OBC: typically below ₹1 lakh annual income.
  - For SC/ST: below ₹2.5 lakh annual income.

BENEFITS:
  - Maintenance allowance as per category and course.
  - Tuition fee reimbursement.
  - Hostel fee support.
  - Exam fee reimbursement.
  - Direct bank transfer via DBT.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via karepass.cgg.gov.in

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit karepass.cgg.gov.in.
  Step 2: Register using Aadhaar and mobile.
  Step 3: Select scholarship category and scheme.
  Step 4: Fill academic and family details.
  Step 5: Upload all required documents.
  Step 6: Submit before deadline.
  Step 7: Institution verifies and forwards; scholarship disbursed via DBT.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Caste / Category Certificate (Karnataka issued)
  - Income Certificate
  - Domicile Certificate (Karnataka)
  - Previous year marksheet
  - Bank passbook
  - Current year admission receipt
  - Institution bonafide certificate

SELECTION PROCESS: Entitlement-based within limits. All eligible applying students are considered.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual application required.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: August–September
  Last Date: December (approximately)

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://karepass.cgg.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: Epass Helpline: 080-40490990 | support@karepass.cgg.gov.in

LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Is Epass only for Karnataka students?
  A1: Yes, it is a Karnataka-specific portal.
  Q2: What categories are covered?
  A2: SC, ST, Category I, IIA, IIB, IIIA, IIIB (OBC), Minority, and EBC.
  Q3: Can engineering students apply?
  A3: Yes, BTech/BE students from SC/ST/OBC/Minority can apply.
  Q4: Is there a caste certificate requirement?
  A4: Yes, a Karnataka-issued caste certificate is mandatory.
  Q5: When should I apply?
  A5: Apply in August–September each academic year.

  A6: No, Epass is state-level; NSP is central government. Both can be availed if eligible for different schemes.
  Q7: Can private college students apply?
  A7: Yes, if the institution is recognized by the state government.

  - Applying after deadline
  - Institution not recognized

SUMMARY: PM WANI is a scheme to proliferate broadband internet access across India through a decentralized framework of public Wi-Fi hotspots without requiring any license or registration fee for setting up public data offices.

PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Women and Child Development

APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Children aged 0–6 years, pregnant and lactating mothers, adolescent girls
SUMMARY: ICDS is India's largest programme for early childhood development, providing nutrition, health care, and pre-school education through a network of Anganwadi Centres across India.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Improve the nutritional and health status of children aged 0–6 years.
  - Lay the foundation for proper psychological, physical, and social development of children.
  - Reduce mortality, morbidity, malnutrition, and school dropout.
  - Achieve effective coordination between policy and implementation.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Children aged 0–6 years.
  - Pregnant and lactating mothers.
  - Adolescent girls aged 11–14 years (in some states).
  - All categories – no income restriction.
  - Must be registered at nearest Anganwadi Centre.

BENEFITS:
  - Supplementary nutrition (hot cooked meal or take-home ration).
  - Immunization services.
  - Health checkup every month.
  - Referral services for sick children.
  - Pre-school non-formal education for children 3–6 years.
  - Nutrition and health education for mothers.
  - Growth monitoring.

APPLICATION MODE: Visit nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC)

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit the nearest Anganwadi Centre in your area.
  Step 2: Register the child and mother's details.
  Step 3: Access all services provided at the centre.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Birth certificate of child
  - Aadhaar Card of mother
  - Residence proof

SELECTION PROCESS: Universal – no selection. All eligible in the catchment area of Anganwadi are covered.

  A3: No, the primary target is 0–6 years. Pre-school is for 3–6 years.

  A4: Yes, Anganwadis are present in both rural and urban areas.

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
SCHEME ID: SEN-001
CATEGORY: Senior Citizen Welfare / Pension / Insurance
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Finance / LIC of India
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above
SUMMARY: PMVVY is a pension scheme for senior citizens that provides guaranteed pension income at a specified return on their investment. Administered by LIC of India. Provides regular monthly/quarterly/annual pension for 10 years.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide social security and regular pension income to senior citizens.
  - Protect senior citizens from falling interest rates.
  - Provide guaranteed returns on retirement savings.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Age: 60 years and above.
  - Indian citizen.
  - No upper age limit.
  - No medical examination required.

BENEFITS:
  - Guaranteed pension at 7.4% per annum for 10-year policy term.
  - Maximum investment: ₹15 lakh per senior citizen.
  - Monthly pension up to ₹9,250 on maximum investment.
  - Pension options: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annually.
  - Full purchase price returned to nominee on death.
  - Loan facility available after 3 years (up to 75% of purchase price).
  - Premature exit allowed on serious illness.

APPLICATION MODE: Online (licindia.in) or through LIC offices/agents

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit licindia.in or nearest LIC branch.
  Step 2: Approach LIC agent or fill online form.
  Step 3: Provide age proof and Aadhaar.
  Step 4: Deposit lump sum amount.
  Step 5: Pension starts from next month/period.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Age proof (60+ years)
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank account for pension credit
  - PAN Card

SELECTION PROCESS: Voluntary purchase – open to all eligible senior citizens.
RENEWAL RULES: 10-year term policy. No annual renewal.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Ongoing: Active – available through LIC

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://licindia.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: LIC Customer Service: 022-67819281 | 1800-33-4433

  Q1: What is the minimum investment?
  A1: Minimum: ₹1.5 lakh for monthly pension of ₹1,000.
  Q2: Is the return guaranteed?
  A2: Yes, 7.4% per annum is guaranteed for the policy term.
  Q3: What happens after 10 years?
  A3: You get back the full purchase price.
  Q4: Is loan facility available?
  A4: Yes, up to 75% of purchase price after 3 years.
  Q5: Can NRI apply?
  A5: NRIs are generally not eligible; it is for resident Indian senior citizens.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Age below 60
  - Investment above ₹15 lakh limit
  - NRI status

SCHEME: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihood Mission (DAY-NRLM)
SCHEME ID: RUR-001
CATEGORY: Rural Development / Women Empowerment / Livelihood
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Rural Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (rural areas)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Rural poor households, especially women
SUMMARY: DAY-NRLM is a poverty alleviation programme that focuses on empowering rural women through Self-Help Groups (SHGs), providing credit access, skill development, and market linkages to improve livelihoods.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Mobilize rural poor into self-help groups.
  - Provide financial inclusion through SHG-bank linkage.
  - Create sustainable livelihoods for rural poor.
  - Empower rural women financially and socially.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Rural poor households.
  - Primarily focuses on women in rural areas.
  - BPL and APL families in rural areas.
  - SHG formation: 10–20 members per group.

BENEFITS:
  - Revolving Fund of ₹15,000 per SHG for immediate needs.
  - Community Investment Fund (CIF) for economic activities.
  - Bank loans at reduced interest (7% for SHG women; government subvention on extra interest).
  - Skill development and placement support.
  - Digital and financial literacy training.
  - Marketing support through state livelihood missions.

APPLICATION MODE: Through Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / State Rural Livelihood Mission

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Form or join a Self-Help Group in your village.
  Step 2: SHG registers at Gram Panchayat.
  Step 3: Regular group savings begin.
  Step 4: After 3–6 months, revolving fund released.
  Step 5: Bank linkage for formal credit.
  Step 6: Livelihood activities begin.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card of members
  - Bank account (group account)
  - BPL certificate (if applicable)
  - SHG registration documents

SELECTION PROCESS: Open to all rural poor who form/join SHGs.
RENEWAL RULES: Continuous program. SHG activities ongoing.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: 2011
  Ongoing: Active

  A1: A Self-Help Group is a group of 10–20 rural women who save together and access credit.

  A2: No, DAY-NRLM is for rural areas. Urban has DAY-NULM.
  Q3: What interest rate do SHGs get?
  A3: 7% per annum on bank loans up to ₹3 lakh; government pays excess interest.
  Q4: Can men join SHGs?
  A4: Primarily women, but some states allow mixed SHGs.
  Q5: Is there any direct cash benefit?
  A5: Revolving Fund of ₹15,000 per SHG is provided as grant.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Urban resident

SCHEME: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
SCHEME ID: SCH-006
CATEGORY: Scholarship / ST Welfare
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: ST students studying at post-matric level (Class 11 and above)
SUMMARY: Provides financial assistance to ST students studying at post-matriculation stage to enable them to complete education. Covers maintenance, tuition fees, and other educational expenses.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Enable ST students to pursue higher education without financial hardship.
  - Reduce dropout rate among Scheduled Tribe students.
  - Cover all costs of education from Class 11 up to PhD.
  - Promote literacy and skill development in tribal communities.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
  - Annual parental income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.
  - Must be studying in Class 11 or above.
  - Must be enrolled in a recognized institution.
  - Full-time students only.
  - Not availing any other overlapping scholarship.

BENEFITS:
  - Maintenance allowance: ₹1,200–₹1,600 per month depending on course.
  - Tuition fee reimbursement as per actuals.
  - Book, study tour, and thesis allowances for eligible courses.
  - Additional support for hostellers.
  - Direct bank transfer via DBT.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via NSP (scholarships.gov.in) and state tribal portals

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Register on scholarships.gov.in with Aadhaar.
  Step 2: Select 'Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students'.
  Step 3: Fill personal, academic, and bank details.
  Step 4: Upload ST certificate, income certificate, and marksheets.
  Step 5: Submit and track through institute and state verification.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - ST Caste Certificate
  - Income Certificate (below ₹2.5 lakh)
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Last qualifying exam marksheet
  - Bank account passbook
  - Current year fee receipt
  - Bonafide certificate
  - Domicile certificate
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: Entitlement-based — all eligible ST applicants satisfying criteria are selected.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual. Must pass previous year exam. Fresh income certificate each year.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Application Open: July (annually)
  Last Date: November 30 (varies by state)

  Q3: Is PhD covered?
  A3: Yes, up to PhD level is covered.

  A4: Yes, if institution is recognized by UGC/AICTE/state government.

SUMMARY: MANF provides five-year fellowship (JRF + SRF) to minority community students pursuing MPhil and PhD in universities/institutions recognized by UGC. It covers research expenses and living allowances.
