SCHEME: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
SCHEME ID: SCH-011
CATEGORY: Scholarship / School Education
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Education (School Education & Literacy)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Class 9–12
SUMMARY: NMMS awards scholarships to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest their dropout at Class 8 level and encourage them to continue their education at secondary and higher secondary level.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Reduce dropout rate at Class 8 transition.
  - Encourage bright students from poor families to continue schooling.
  - Provide financial support for Class 9 to 12 education.
  - Promote meritocracy in school education.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Student must be in Class 8 to apply (scholarship for Class 9–12).
  - Must have scored at least 55% in Class 7 final exam (50% for SC/ST).
  - Annual parental income must not exceed ₹3.5 lakh.
  - Must be studying in a government, government-aided, or local body school.
  - Students in private schools are NOT eligible.
  - Must pass the state-level NMMS examination.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) for Class 9 to 12.
  - 1 lakh scholarships awarded nationally per year.
  - Directly credited to student's bank account.

APPLICATION MODE: State-level examination — apply through school

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Get application form from your school (government or aided school).
  Step 2: Fill form and submit to school with required documents.
  Step 3: Appear for state-level NMMS examination (Mental Ability Test + Scholastic Aptitude Test).
  Step 4: Selected students get scholarship via DBT.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Class 7 marksheet (55%+)
  - Income certificate (below ₹3.5 lakh)
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank passbook
  - School enrollment proof
  - Caste certificate (for SC/ST)

SELECTION PROCESS: Competitive — state-level NMMS examination. 1 lakh slots nationally.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual — must maintain 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in each class.

  A3: Mental Ability Test (MAT) + Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT).

  A4: No, NMMS is also administered through NSP after selection.

SCHEME: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
SCHEME ID: HLTH-002
CATEGORY: Healthcare / Maternity / Mother and Child Health
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Mission
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (higher cash incentive in Low Performing States — LPS)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Pregnant women below poverty line (BPL) and SC/ST women
SUMMARY: JSY promotes institutional delivery among poor pregnant women by providing cash assistance to mothers who deliver in government or accredited private health facilities, thus reducing maternal and neonatal mortality.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Reduce maternal and infant mortality.
  - Promote institutional delivery over home delivery.
  - Provide financial assistance to BPL/SC/ST pregnant women for delivery.
  - Engage ASHAs (community health workers) to facilitate institutional births.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All pregnant women below poverty line (BPL), SC, and ST women.
  - In High Performing States (HPS), only BPL/SC/ST women qualify for full benefit.
  - In Low Performing States (LPS), all pregnant women are eligible regardless of income.
  - Delivery must be at government health facility or ASHA-empanelled private facility.
  - No restriction on birth order in LPS states.
  - In HPS: only up to two live births.

BENEFITS:
  - LPS rural: ₹1,400 per delivery to mother.
  - LPS urban: ₹1,000 per delivery to mother.
  - HPS rural: ₹700 per delivery.
  - HPS urban: ₹600 per delivery.
  - ASHA worker gets ₹600 (rural LPS) for each institutional delivery facilitated.
  - C-section and complicated deliveries also covered.

APPLICATION MODE: Offline — register at nearest government health facility / ASHA worker

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi/health centre.
  Step 2: Contact local ASHA worker for support.
  Step 3: Deliver at government hospital or empanelled facility.
  Step 4: ASHA facilitates cash benefit disbursement to mother's bank account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - BPL/Ration Card (or ST certificate)
  - Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card

SUMMARY: ABDM creates a digital health ecosystem for India by providing every citizen with a unique Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) ID (14-digit health ID). Enables secure sharing of health records across hospitals and doctors.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Create a universal health ID for all Indians.
  - Enable digital health records accessible across providers.

  - Improve continuity of care and reduce paperwork.

  - All Indian citizens.
  - No income or category restriction.
  - Can be created from birth.

BENEFITS:

  - Access to health facility registry and provider directory.

  Step 3: Generate 14-digit ABHA number.
  Step 4: Link your health records to ABHA ID.

SUMMARY: PMSMA provides free, comprehensive antenatal care (ANC) to pregnant women on the 9th of every month at designated government health facilities. Includes free check-ups, investigations, and iron supplements.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide quality antenatal care to every pregnant woman.
  - Ensure early detection of high-risk pregnancies.
  - Reduce maternal and infant mortality.
  - Guarantee at least one quality ANC checkup for all pregnant women.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All pregnant women in second trimester (14 weeks+) or third trimester.
  - No income or category restriction.
  - Applicable at government health facilities.

BENEFITS:
  - Free complete ANC checkup on 9th of every month.
  - Blood pressure, hemoglobin, blood sugar, and weight check.
  - Urine analysis and abdominal examination.
  - Free iron, folic acid, and calcium supplements.
  - Free ultrasound at district hospitals.
  - High-risk pregnancy identification and referral.

APPLICATION MODE: No application needed — visit nearest government health centre on 9th of any month

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit nearest government PHC, CHC, or district hospital on 9th of month.
  Step 2: Carry MCP card and Aadhaar.
  Step 3: Get free antenatal checkup.
  Step 4: Collect supplements and follow-up advice.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card
  - Aadhaar Card (recommended)

SELECTION PROCESS: Universal — no selection. All pregnant women can avail.
RENEWAL RULES: Monthly on every 9th — multiple visits encouraged.

PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government

TARGET BENEFICIARIES: BPL patients with life-threatening diseases treated at government hospitals
SUMMARY: RAN provides financial assistance up to ₹15 lakh to BPL patients suffering from life-threatening diseases requiring treatment at government super-specialty hospitals including central government hospitals.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide financial relief to critically ill BPL patients.
  - Enable poor patients to access super-specialty treatment.
  - Cover life-threatening diseases requiring expensive procedures.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be below poverty line (BPL).
  - Must have life-threatening disease requiring super-specialty treatment.
  - Treatment must be at government super-specialty or AIIMS-level hospital.
  - Diseases covered: cancer, kidney failure, liver failure, heart disease, organ transplant, etc.

BENEFITS:
  - One-time financial assistance up to ₹15 lakh.
  - Covers cost of treatment, surgery, and medicines.
  - Direct payment to hospital on behalf of patient.
  - Exceptional cases may receive higher grants.

APPLICATION MODE: Through Medical Superintendent of treating government hospital

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Approach Medical Superintendent of treating government hospital.
  Step 2: Hospital verifies BPL status and treatment need.
  Step 3: Application forwarded to Ministry of Health.
  Step 4: Ministry approves and transfers funds to hospital.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - BPL certificate
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Medical report and diagnosis
  - Estimate of treatment cost from hospital
  - Income proof

SELECTION PROCESS: Case-by-case review by Ministry. Based on BPL status and disease severity.

SCHEME: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
SCHEME ID: FARM-003
CATEGORY: Farmer Welfare / Credit / Agriculture
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Agriculture / NABARD / Scheduled Commercial Banks
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Farmers, fishermen, and allied agricultural workers needing short-term credit
SUMMARY: Kisan Credit Card provides farmers with timely and adequate credit for agricultural operations, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, consumption requirements, and maintenance of farm assets at a low interest rate.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide easy and timely credit to farmers.
  - Reduce dependence on moneylenders.
  - Cover full agricultural credit cycle.
  - Extend credit to fishermen and animal husbandry farmers.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All farmers — individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers.
  - SHG or Joint Liability Group of farmers.
  - Fishermen and fish farmers.
  - Animal husbandry farmers.
  - No income limit — based on land holding and crop pattern.

BENEFITS:
  - Revolving credit limit based on land holding and crop requirements.
  - Interest rate: 7% per annum (with 2% interest subvention by government).
  - Effective interest rate: 4% for timely repayment (3% additional incentive).
  - Credit limit calculated for 5 years.
  - Built-in personal accident insurance of ₹50,000.
  - Can be used like a debit card at ATMs or for purchases.
  - Post-harvest credit and allied activities also covered.

APPLICATION MODE: Through nearest bank branch (commercial, cooperative, RRB)

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit nearest bank branch or Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS).
  Step 2: Fill KCC application form.
  Step 3: Submit land records, identity proof, and address proof.
  Step 4: Bank assesses credit limit based on scale of finance.
  Step 5: KCC issued with a credit limit.
  Step 6: Withdraw as needed and repay after harvest.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Land records (7/12 extract or Khasra)
  - Aadhaar Card
  - PAN Card
  - Photograph
  - Bank account details
  - Proof of land ownership/tenancy

SELECTION PROCESS: Credit assessment by bank based on land records and repayment history.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual review of credit limit. Card valid for 5 years.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: 1998
  Ongoing: Active

  A1: 7% per annum; effectively 4% with government interest subvention for timely repayment.
  Q2: Can tenant farmers get KCC?
  A2: Yes, tenant farmers and sharecroppers are eligible.
  Q3: Can fishermen apply?
  A3: Yes, KCC has been extended to fishermen and animal husbandry farmers.
  Q4: What is the maximum credit limit?
  A4: No fixed maximum — based on scale of finance for crops.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Poor credit history

  - Land in dispute

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
SCHEME ID: FARM-004
CATEGORY: Farmer Welfare / Irrigation / Agriculture
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Agriculture
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Farmers in water-stressed areas, farmer groups, water user associations
SUMMARY: PMKSY aims to achieve convergence of investments in irrigation at the field level, expand cultivable area under assured irrigation, improve on-farm water use efficiency, and introduce sustainable conservation practices with 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and 'More Crop Per Drop' approach.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide end-to-end solutions in irrigation supply chain.
  - Expand irrigated area coverage ('Har Khet Ko Pani').
  - Improve water use efficiency ('More Crop Per Drop').
  - Enhance recharge of aquifers and water conservation.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All farmers — individual or farmer groups.
  - Water User Associations (WUA) can apply.
  - Farmers in watershed areas, canal commands, and water-stressed zones.
  - For micro-irrigation: farmers with any holding size.

BENEFITS:
  - Per Drop More Crop: subsidy on micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler) systems.
  - Individual farmers: 45% subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment.
  - Small/marginal farmers: 55% subsidy on micro-irrigation.
  - Watershed development support for rainfed areas.
  - Ground water development for assured irrigation.

APPLICATION MODE: Through state agriculture / horticulture department or online portals

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Contact district agriculture office or visit state irrigation portal.
  Step 2: Apply for subsidy on micro-irrigation components.
  Step 3: Install approved drip/sprinkler system.
  Step 4: Subsidy credited to bank account after installation verification.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Land records
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank passbook
  - Quotation from approved vendor for equipment
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: Application-based subsidy. Priority to small/marginal farmers.
RENEWAL RULES: One-time subsidy for equipment. Additional schemes for watershed annual.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: July 1, 2015
  Ongoing: Active

  A1: 45–55% subsidy on drip irrigation equipment cost depending on farmer category.

  A2: Yes, canal system development is covered under PMKSY's Accelerated Irrigation Benefits Programme.
  Q3: Is drip irrigation equipment free?
  A3: No, farmer pays 45–55% and gets subsidy for the rest.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Equipment not from approved vendor list
  - Land not in farmer's name

SCHEME: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
SCHEME ID: EMPL-003
CATEGORY: Skill Development / Rural Employment
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Rural Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (rural areas)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Rural youth aged 15–35 from poor families
SUMMARY: DDU-GKY is a demand-driven placement-linked skill development programme for rural youth from poor families. Provides free residential skill training with guaranteed placement in formal sector jobs.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide market-relevant skills to rural poor youth.
  - Guarantee placement in formal sector jobs after training.
  - Improve livelihoods of rural youth.
  - Enable rural-to-urban migration in a structured manner.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Age: 15–35 years (up to 45 for SC/ST/women/PwD).
  - Must be from a rural area.
  - Annual family income below poverty line (BPL) or MGNREGA job card holder.
  - Minimum educational qualification varies by course.
  - Preference to SC/ST, minorities, women, and PwD.

BENEFITS:
  - Free skill training (residential programme).
  - Free accommodation, food, and travel during training.
  - Guaranteed placement post training (minimum wage or above).
  - Post-placement tracking and support for 1 year.
  - Career progression support.
  - Training in sectors like IT, retail, healthcare, hospitality, construction.

APPLICATION MODE: Through Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs) at district level

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Contact nearest District Rural Development Authority (DRDA).
  Step 2: Register as candidate with rural domicile proof.
  Step 3: Enroll in available DDU-GKY course.
  Step 4: Complete residential training.
  Step 5: Get placed through PIA network.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Rural domicile/residence proof
  - MGNREGA job card (if applicable)
  - Income/BPL certificate
  - Educational qualification certificate
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: First-come-first-served with priority to SC/ST/women/PwD.
RENEWAL RULES: One course per candidate. Repeat enrollment possible.

  A2: Yes, DDU-GKY is predominantly residential with free food and accommodation.

  A3: IT, retail, healthcare, hospitality, construction, agriculture value chain, and more.
  Q4: Can women apply?
  A4: Yes, at least 33% of trainees must be women.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Not from rural area

SCHEME: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
SCHEME ID: EMPL-004
CATEGORY: Skill Development / Employment / Apprenticeship
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship / MSDE
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Youth pursuing apprenticeship in industry; employers offering apprenticeships
SUMMARY: NAPS promotes apprenticeship training in India by sharing the stipend cost between the government and employer. It helps youth gain on-the-job experience in real industry settings with financial support.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Increase the number of apprentices in India.
  - Reduce cost burden on employers to encourage apprenticeship.
  - Provide industry-relevant experience to youth.
  - Bridge skill gap between education and employment.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Youth who have passed minimum Class 5 (varies by trade).
  - Age: 14–21 years for apprenticeship under Apprentices Act.
  - Any employer in industry, business, or service sector can enroll apprentices.
  - ITI graduates, diploma holders, and engineering graduates can apply.

BENEFITS:
  - Government shares 25% of stipend (up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice).
  - Apprentice gets monthly stipend from employer + government share.
  - Nationally recognized Certificate of Apprenticeship on completion.
  - Direct industry experience in over 1,000 trades.
  - For graduates/diploma holders: monthly stipend ₹3,000–₹9,000+.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
  Step 2: Register as apprentice candidate.
  Step 3: Search for apprenticeship openings in desired trade and location.
  Step 4: Apply and get selected by employer.
  Step 5: Contract registered on portal.
  Step 6: Begin apprenticeship and receive monthly stipend.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Educational qualification certificate (ITI/Diploma/Degree/10th pass)
  - Bank account passbook
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: By employer based on qualifications and interview.
RENEWAL RULES: Apprenticeship period: 6 months to 3 years depending on trade.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: 2016
  Ongoing: Active

TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Street vendors who lost livelihood due to COVID-19; urban street vendors
SUMMARY: PM SVANidhi provides affordable collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods. Promotes financial inclusion among urban informal sector workers.

OBJECTIVES:

  - Provide affordable microcredit to street vendors.
  - Promote digital transactions among street vendors.

  - Second loan: ₹20,000 on timely repayment.
  - Third loan: ₹50,000 on continued timely repayment.

  Step 2: Register with Aadhaar and mobile.
  Step 3: Apply for loan with vending certificate or ULB letter.
  Step 4: Loan processed through bank or MFI partner.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card

SELECTION PROCESS: All eligible street vendors can apply.

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
SCHEME ID: HOUS-002
CATEGORY: Housing / Urban Development
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India (urban areas)
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Urban poor including EWS, LIG, and MIG categories wanting their first home
SUMMARY: PMAY-U aims to provide affordable housing to all urban residents by 2024 through credit-linked subsidy, in-situ slum rehabilitation, affordable housing in partnership, and beneficiary-led construction.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Housing for All in urban areas.
  - Provide affordable housing to EWS, LIG, and MIG families.
  - Reduce housing deficit in urban India.
  - Improve slum infrastructure and rehabilitation.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - EWS (Economically Weaker Section): Annual income up to ₹3 lakh.
  - LIG (Low Income Group): Annual income ₹3–6 lakh.
  - MIG-I (Middle Income Group I): Annual income ₹6–12 lakh.
  - MIG-II (Middle Income Group II): Annual income ₹12–18 lakh.
  - Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
  - For CLSS: Must be first-time homebuyer.
  - Female head of household preferred; property must be in woman's name for EWS/LIG.

BENEFITS:
  - EWS/LIG: Credit-linked subsidy of 6.5% on loan up to ₹6 lakh (max subsidy ₹2.67 lakh).
  - MIG-I: 4% subsidy on loan up to ₹9 lakh.
  - MIG-II: 3% subsidy on loan up to ₹12 lakh.
  - In-situ slum rehabilitation: ₹1 lakh per beneficiary from central government.
  - Affordable Housing in Partnership: ₹1.5 lakh central assistance.
  - Beneficiary-Led Construction: ₹1.5 lakh for new construction/enhancement.

APPLICATION MODE: Online at pmaymis.gov.in or through lending institutions/Urban Local Bodies

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit pmaymis.gov.in.
  Step 2: Select appropriate component (CLSS/BLC/AHP/ISSR).
  Step 3: Register with Aadhaar.
  Step 4: Fill income, family, and property details.
  Step 5: Submit to nearest ULB or bank.
  Step 6: Subsidy directly credited to loan account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Income proof
  - Self-declaration of no pucca house
  - Property documents
  - Bank account details
  - Caste certificate (if applicable)

SELECTION PROCESS: Eligibility-based. All qualifying urban residents can apply.
RENEWAL RULES: One-time subsidy benefit. Not renewable.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: June 25, 2015
  Extended To: December 2024

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://pmaymis.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PMAY-U Helpline: 1800-11-3388 | pmaymis-mhupa@gov.in
SOURCE: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can a salaried person apply?
  A1: Yes, as long as annual income is within category limits and no pucca house is owned.
  Q2: Is the subsidy on total loan or part?
  A2: Subsidy is on the first ₹6/9/12 lakh of loan depending on income category.
  Q3: Must property be in woman's name?
  A3: For EWS/LIG, property must be in woman's name or co-ownership. Encouraged for MIG too.
  Q4: What is CLSS?
  A4: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme — interest subsidy on home loan.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Already owns pucca house
  - Income above ₹18 lakh
  - Not first-time homebuyer (for CLSS)
  - Not in urban area

  Step 1: Visit any bank branch, Post Office Savings Bank, or Business Correspondent.

SUMMARY: PMMY provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to small businesses and entrepreneurs for income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading, and service sectors through Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Fund the unfunded — provide credit to micro enterprises.
  - Promote entrepreneurship and self-employment.
  - Support income-generating activities at micro level.
  - Reduce dependence on informal moneylenders.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Non-farm income-generating micro enterprises.
  - Individuals, proprietorships, partnerships, and companies.
  - Manufacturing, trading, or service sector business.
  - No minimum education or income requirement.
  - No collateral required for Shishu and Kishore loans.

BENEFITS:
  - Shishu: loans up to ₹50,000 (for micro/start-up businesses).
  - Kishore: loans from ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh.
  - Tarun: loans from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.
  - No collateral for loans up to ₹10 lakh.
  - Interest rate at bank's discretion (generally 8–12%).
  - MUDRA card (working capital in debit card form) for eligible borrowers.

APPLICATION MODE: Through commercial banks, RRBs, MFIs, cooperative banks, and online

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit nearest bank branch or MUDRA partner lender.
  Step 2: Fill loan application with business plan.
  Step 3: Submit KYC and business documents.
  Step 4: Bank evaluates and sanctions loan.
  Step 5: Loan disbursed to bank account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - PAN Card
  - Business proof / business plan
  - Address proof
  - Bank account details
  - Photographs

RENEWAL RULES: Loan repayment as per schedule. Can apply for fresh loan after repayment.

APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Traditional artisans and craftspeople from 18 designated trades
SUMMARY: PM Vishwakarma is a central sector scheme that recognizes and supports traditional artisans and craftspeople with skill training, modern tools, digital and green technology access, MSME linkage, and credit at subsidized rates.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Uplift traditional artisans and craftspeople.
  - Provide skill enhancement and modern tools.
  - Enable market linkages and credit access.
  - Preserve traditional crafts and skills.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be engaged in one of 18 designated trades:
  - Carpenter, Boat Maker, Armourer, Blacksmith, Hammer and Tool Kit Maker, Locksmith, Goldsmith,
  - Potter, Sculptor/Stone Carver, Cobbler/Shoemaker, Mason, Basket/Mat/Broom Maker,
  - Doll & Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker.
  - Must be 18+ years old.
  - Self-employed/working in unorganized sector.

BENEFITS:
  - PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card.
  - Basic skill training: ₹500/day stipend for 5–7 days.
  - Advanced skill training: ₹500/day for 15 days.

  Step 5: Apply for toolkit incentive and credit.

  - Aadhaar Card with biometric verification
  - Trade practice proof
  - Bank account passbook
  - Mobile number

SELECTION PROCESS: Registration-based. All eligible artisans from 18 trades can register.

SCHEME: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
SCHEME ID: DIS-002
CATEGORY: Disability Support / Assistive Devices
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Persons with disabilities (PwD) from low-income families needing assistive devices
SUMMARY: ADIP scheme provides assistive devices — wheelchairs, hearing aids, white canes, tricycles, braille kits, artificial limbs, CWSN aids — to persons with disabilities from low-income families at free or subsidized cost.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide modern assistive devices to PwD from poor families.
  - Improve physical, social, and economic rehabilitation of disabled persons.
  - Reduce cost burden of assistive devices on poor families with disabled members.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Persons with disabilities with at least 40% disability.
  - Annual family income must not exceed ₹2 lakh for free devices.
  - Subsidized devices for income ₹2–3 lakh.
  - Indian citizen.
  - Age: no restriction.

BENEFITS:
  - Free assistive devices for income below ₹2 lakh.
  - Subsidized devices for income ₹2–3 lakh.
  - Devices include: wheelchair, hearing aid, white cane, tricycle, artificial limb, CWSN aids, braille kit.
  - Devices provided through distribution camps organized by ALIMCO and NGOs.
  - Cost: from ₹500 to ₹1.5 lakh per device depending on type.

APPLICATION MODE: Through ALIMCO / state social welfare departments / camp registration

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Register at ADIP camp organized by ALIMCO or contact state social welfare department.
  Step 2: Get medical assessment by government doctor.
  Step 3: Device prescribed based on disability type.
  Step 4: Device provided on the spot or delivered.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Disability Certificate (40%+)
  - Income certificate
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Photograph
  - Age proof

SELECTION PROCESS: Priority to severe disability and lower income.
RENEWAL RULES: Devices replaced after prescribed useful life (3–5 years typically).

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Ongoing: Regular camps across India — check state announcements

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://alimco.in | https://socialjustice.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: ALIMCO: 0512-2770873 | Social Justice: 011-23381010

  A1: Yes, free for income below ₹2 lakh with 40%+ disability.

  A2: Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India — government manufacturer of assistive devices.
  Q3: How to find next camp?
  A3: Check ALIMCO website or contact state social welfare department.
  Q4: Can hearing aid be obtained?
  A4: Yes, hearing aids are provided free/subsidized under ADIP.

  - Disability below 40%

PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government (State Implemented)
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: BPL persons with severe/multiple disabilities aged 18–79 years
SUMMARY: IGNDPS under NSAP provides monthly pension to BPL individuals with severe or multiple disabilities to ensure income security and social protection.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide social protection to disabled BPL individuals.
  - Ensure minimum income for disabled persons without livelihood.
  - Reduce poverty among disabled population.

  - Must be below poverty line (BPL).
  - Must have severe disability (80%+ or multiple disability 40%+).
  - Valid disability certificate from government medical authority.

  Step 1: Visit nearest Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office.
  Step 2: Submit disability pension application.
  Step 3: Verification by GP and social welfare office.
  Step 4: Pension credited monthly to bank account.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Disability Certificate (80%+ or multiple 40%+)
  - BPL certificate / SECC entry

  - Photograph

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) – Free LPG Connection
SCHEME ID: MISC-001
CATEGORY: Women Welfare / Rural Welfare / Energy
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Adult women from BPL/SECC/SC/ST/OBC/EBC/forest dwellers households without LPG connection
SUMMARY: PMUY provides free LPG connections to women from BPL households, eliminating the use of unclean cooking fuels and improving health outcomes for women and children. Phase 2 (Ujjwala 2.0) expanded to migrant workers.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide clean cooking fuel to BPL households.
  - Improve health outcomes by reducing indoor air pollution.
  - Empower women through clean energy access.
  - Reduce respiratory diseases caused by biomass burning.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Adult women above 18 years.
  - Must not have any existing LPG connection in the household.
  - BPL household (SECC 2011) or any of: SC/ST, PMAY beneficiary, forest dwellers, tea garden workers, most backward classes.
  - Ujjwala 2.0: migrant workers and those not in SECC also eligible.

BENEFITS:
  - Free LPG connection (security deposit and first refill borne by government).
  - Free first refill under Ujjwala 2.0.
  - Free stove / hot plate for first connection.
  - 8 crore+ connections already distributed nationally.

APPLICATION MODE: Online at pmuy.gov.in or offline at nearest LPG distributor

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit pmuy.gov.in or nearest LPG distributor (IndanGas, HP Gas, Bharat Gas).
  Step 2: Fill KYC form with Aadhaar and bank details.
  Step 3: Submit declaration of BPL status / self-declaration for Ujjwala 2.0.
  Step 4: LPG connection and cylinder delivered to home.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - BPL certificate (or self-declaration for Ujjwala 2.0)
  - Bank account passbook
  - Address proof
  - Photograph

SELECTION PROCESS: All eligible women who apply are covered.
RENEWAL RULES: One-time connection. Ongoing subsidized refills.

SUMMARY: Saubhagya aims to achieve universal household electrification in India by providing free electricity connections to all BPL households and subsidized connections to APL households in rural and urban areas.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Electrify every un-electrified household in India.
  - Provide free connections to BPL households.

  Step 1: Contact local DISCOM or Gram Panchayat.
  Step 2: Submit BPL certificate / ration card and Aadhaar.
  Step 3: Connection established within a week in rural areas.

  - Address proof

SCHEME: National Food Security Act (NFSA) – Ration Card / PDS
SCHEME ID: MISC-004
CATEGORY: Food Security / Rural Welfare / Urban Welfare
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government (State Implemented)
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: 75% of rural and 50% of urban population (approx 81 crore beneficiaries)
SUMMARY: NFSA ensures food security for eligible households through the Public Distribution System (PDS) providing subsidized/free food grains. Priority Households get 5 kg grains per person per month; Antyodaya families get 35 kg per month.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Ensure food and nutritional security for population.
  - Provide subsidized/free food grains to eligible households.
  - Reduce hunger and malnutrition.
  - Implement right to food as a legal entitlement.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Priority Households (PHH): state-determined eligibility. Annual income below threshold.
  - Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY): poorest of poor — landless labour, rural artisans, slum dwellers.
  - No restriction on category — all poor households.

BENEFITS:
  - Priority Households: 5 kg grain per person per month.
  - AAY Families: 35 kg grain per family per month.
  - Under PMGKAY (PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana): additional free grain — effectively all grain free.
  - Grains: wheat, rice, millets at highly subsidized or zero cost.
  - Portability: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) — use ration card across India.

APPLICATION MODE: Apply for ration card at State Food Department / Tehsil / e-Ration card portal

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Visit state food department office or online ration card portal.
  Step 2: Fill application with family details.
  Step 3: Attach Aadhaar of all family members.
  Step 4: Income and residence verification.
  Step 5: Ration card issued; collect subsidized grain monthly from Fair Price Shop.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card (all family members)
  - Income proof
  - Address proof
  - Recent photograph
  - Gas connection details (for deletion of non-eligible)

SELECTION PROCESS: State government determines eligible households based on NFSA criteria.
RENEWAL RULES: Annual verification of ration card.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Enacted: 2013
  Ongoing: Active — PMGKAY extended annually

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://nfsa.gov.in | https://epos.telangana.gov.in (state portals)
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PDS Helpline: 1967 | Food Ministry: 1800-11-4000
SOURCE: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

  Q1: Can I use ration card in another state?
  A1: Yes, One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) allows portability across states.
  Q2: Are grains free under PMGKAY?
  A2: Yes, PMGKAY provides free grains to NFSA beneficiaries.
  Q3: What is AAY?
  A3: Antyodaya Anna Yojana — for the poorest families who get 35 kg/month.
  Q4: How many people in India have ration cards?
  A4: Approximately 81 crore people covered under NFSA.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Income above NFSA threshold
  - Already enrolled in another state
  - Duplicate card

PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Rural Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government (State Implemented)
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: BPL widows aged 40 years and above
SUMMARY: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) under NSAP provides monthly pension to widows from BPL households to ensure their basic income security.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide social protection to destitute widows.
  - Ensure minimum income support for widows without livelihood.
  - Reduce poverty among widowed women.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Must be a widow (husband deceased).
  - Age: 40 years and above.
  - Must be below poverty line (BPL).
  - No other pension or significant income.

BENEFITS:
  - ₹300 per month from central government.
  - States add additional amount (typically total ₹500–₹2,000/month).
  - Monthly payment via DBT.

APPLICATION MODE: Offline at Gram Panchayat / Block Office / Urban Local Body

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Apply at Gram Panchayat or urban ward office.
  Step 2: Submit widow certificate (husband's death certificate), BPL proof, and Aadhaar.
  Step 3: Verification by GP.
  Step 4: Monthly pension starts after approval.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Husband's death certificate
  - BPL certificate or SECC entry
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Bank passbook
  - Age proof
  - Photograph

SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) – Free Grain
SCHEME ID: MISC-006
CATEGORY: Food Security / COVID Relief / Rural Welfare
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: All NFSA ration card holders (81 crore+ people)
SUMMARY: PMGKAY provides free additional food grains over and above NFSA entitlement to all National Food Security Act (NFSA) beneficiaries. Initially launched as COVID relief in 2020, it has been made permanent from January 2024.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Ensure food security for the poor during and after COVID.
  - Provide free grains to all NFSA beneficiaries.
  - Eliminate food grain cost entirely for 81 crore people.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - All NFSA ration card holders.
  - Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families.
  - Approx. 81.35 crore beneficiaries across India.

BENEFITS:
  - 5 kg free grain per person per month (over and above earlier NFSA entitlement).
  - From January 2024: PMGKAY merged with NFSA — all entitlement now free.
  - Total free grain: 5 kg per person per month for PHH, 35 kg per family for AAY.
  - All types: rice, wheat, or millets as applicable.

APPLICATION MODE: No separate application — automatically available to NFSA beneficiaries at FPS

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Must have valid ration card.
  Step 2: Visit nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS) each month.
  Step 3: Use Aadhaar-based authentication or ration card.
  Step 4: Collect free grain.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Valid ration card
  - Aadhaar for biometric authentication at FPS

SELECTION PROCESS: Automatic for all NFSA beneficiaries.
RENEWAL RULES: Monthly collection. No annual renewal.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Originally Launched: April 2020 (COVID)
  Made Permanent: January 2024

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://nfsa.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PDS Helpline: 1967
SOURCE: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Is PMGKAY free forever now?
  A1: Yes, from January 2024 it is merged with NFSA, making grains free permanently.
  Q2: How much grain do I get?
  A2: 5 kg per person per month for Priority Households; 35 kg per month for AAY families.
  Q3: Do I need to apply separately?
  A3: No, it's automatic for all NFSA ration cardholders.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - No valid NFSA ration card
  - Aadhaar not linked to ration card

SCHEME: PM Awas Yojana – PMAY (Comprehensive Overview)
SCHEME ID: MISC-007
CATEGORY: Housing / Overview Scheme
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: Homeless, kutcha house dwellers, EWS/LIG/MIG families (both rural and urban)
SUMMARY: PMAY is India's Housing for All scheme with two components: PMAY-Gramin (rural) and PMAY-Urban. Together they aim to provide pucca housing to every Indian family by providing subsidies, financial assistance, and credit linkage.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Ensure 'Housing for All' by providing pucca housing.
  - Eliminate homelessness and kutcha housing in India.
  - Provide subsidized housing finance to EWS/LIG/MIG.
  - Integrate basic services (water, electricity, toilet) with housing.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - PMAY-G: Houseless and kutcha house families in SECC 2011 rural list.
  - PMAY-U: Urban households in EWS (up to ₹3L income), LIG (₹3–6L), MIG-I (₹6–12L), MIG-II (₹12–18L).
  - Must not own any pucca house anywhere in India.
  - Women's name must be included for EWS/LIG.

BENEFITS:
  - PMAY-G: ₹1.2–1.3 lakh financial assistance per unit.
  - PMAY-U CLSS: Up to ₹2.67 lakh interest subsidy on home loan.
  - Basic amenities (toilet under SBM, electricity under Saubhagya, LPG under PMUY).
  - Convergence benefit: all basic services provided together.

APPLICATION MODE: PMAY-G: via GP / pmayg.nic.in | PMAY-U: via pmaymis.gov.in

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Check eligibility on respective portal.
  Step 2: Register with Aadhaar and family details.
  Step 3: Provide land ownership or allotment details.
  Step 4: Complete construction with financial support released in instalments.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Land records / allotment letter
  - Bank passbook
  - SECC identification (for PMAY-G)
  - Income proof (for PMAY-U)

SELECTION PROCESS: PMAY-G: SECC-based. PMAY-U: Income category eligibility.
RENEWAL RULES: One-time benefit per family.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: June 2015
  Extended: 2024–2025

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://pmayg.nic.in | https://pmaymis.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: PMAY-G: 1800-11-6446 | PMAY-U: 1800-11-3388
SOURCE: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Rural Development
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Can I apply for both PMAY-G and PMAY-U?
  A1: No, you can apply for only one depending on your rural/urban status.
  Q2: Is pucca house any house or government house?
  A2: Any pucca house anywhere in India — owning any disqualifies you.
  Q3: Can I get loan for PMAY house?
  A3: Yes, PMAY-U includes Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) on home loans.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - Owns pucca house
  - Income above category limit
  - Not in SECC (for PMAY-G)

SCHEME: DigiLocker – Digital Document Wallet
SCHEME ID: MISC-008
CATEGORY: Digital India / e-Governance / Education
PROVIDED BY: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
SCHEME TYPE: Central Government
APPLICABLE STATES: All India
TARGET BENEFICIARIES: All Indian citizens with Aadhaar
SUMMARY: DigiLocker is a secure cloud-based platform for issuance and verification of documents and certificates digitally. Eliminates need for physical documents — certificates stored and shared digitally.

OBJECTIVES:
  - Provide secure digital document storage to all citizens.
  - Eliminate need for physical document submission.
  - Enable faster government service delivery.
  - Reduce paperwork and administrative burden.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
  - Any Indian citizen with Aadhaar number.
  - No income or category restriction.
  - Available for free.

BENEFITS:
  - 1 GB secure cloud storage for documents.
  - Directly fetch documents from issuers (CBSE, DGS, EPFO, NIC, state boards, etc.).
  - Legally valid under IT Act — accepted everywhere.
  - Driving licence, RC book, Aadhaar, PAN, marksheets all digitally stored.
  - Reduce risk of losing physical documents.

APPLICATION MODE: Online via digilocker.gov.in or DigiLocker app

APPLICATION STEPS:
  Step 1: Download DigiLocker app or visit digilocker.gov.in.
  Step 2: Sign up with mobile number and Aadhaar.
  Step 3: Fetch or upload your documents.
  Step 4: Share documents digitally with government agencies, colleges, etc.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
  - Aadhaar Card for sign-up

SELECTION PROCESS: Universal — free for all citizens.
RENEWAL RULES: Lifetime account.

IMPORTANT DATES:
  Launched: 2015
  Ongoing: Active — 25 crore+ users

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://digilocker.gov.in
OFFICIAL CONTACT: DigiLocker Support: 1800-11-4433
SOURCE: MeitY
LAST VERIFIED: May 2025

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
  Q1: Are DigiLocker documents legally valid?
  A1: Yes, documents issued by government authorities via DigiLocker are legally valid under IT Act.
  Q2: Is it free?
  A2: Yes, completely free.
  Q3: Can I store marksheets?
  A3: Yes, CBSE, ICSE, and most state board marksheets are directly available on DigiLocker.
  Q4: Can I share documents for scholarship applications?
  A4: Yes, DigiLocker documents can be shared with scholarship and government portals.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS:
  - No Aadhaar for sign-up
